errors.description: The button sits at the base of the extension tab and the buttonhole on the tab body; the drawing places the button/buttonhole pair on the receiving waistband to the left of the tab.
errors.expected: Button and buttonhole positioned as drawn on the waistband underlap left of the tab.
errors.actual: Hook-bar on the waistband underlap, button at the tab root, buttonhole down the tab.
errors.correction: Optional: move the button one tab-width left onto the waistband underlap so it mirrors the drawing exactly.

notes: Adversarial pass. The decisive discriminator against the sibling option is the tab END SHAPE, and it is right: the tab tapers to a sharp point rather than finishing square. Both fastenings called for by the label are present and distinguishable — a metal hook-and-bar on the underlap plus a horn button and a worked buttonhole. The tab is shown laid open, which is how the blueprint presents it, so the closure hardware is legible rather than hidden. Only deviation found is which side of the closure carries the button versus the hook, logged minor since both elements are present and the closure type reads correctly in under a second. No red traced into cloth, no numerals, arrows or leader lines anywhere.
